verdict.rationale: Asking whether commercial use needs a paid license is a fair question for an open-source inference engine, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers vLLM's license terms, any commercial or enterprise tier, or whether a paid subscription is required. Install instructions (pip/uv, build from source) do not establish licensing terms.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
